notes: Starting (8) as posted: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (posted 'WYS/Mara and Talon'), Tatooine (posted 'Tat System'), Cantina, DB 94, Squadron Assignments (posted 'Squad Ass.'), Insurrection, Staging Areas, Heading For The Medical Frigate (posted 'HFTMF'); these count toward the 60. Three Effects start and none is singled out, so no starting Effect is set.
'Mara and Talon' in the starting line is the deck's theme name (the author explains Mara and Talon start a smugglers' organization in the books), not a card; no Mara Jade card is in the list.
The deck totals 59 as posted (section counts 8+5+18+4+3+18+1+2).

Posted 'Tat System' dested the Premiere Tatooine system; 'Cantina' dested the Light Tatooine: Cantina; 'CC DB' dested the Light Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay) (the draft had the Dark East Platform); 'Hoth DB' dested Hoth: Echo Docking Bay; 'Back Door' dested Endor: Back Door.

Posted 'Dash' dested Dash Rendar (listed under characters; the draft had the Dash interrupt); 'Wedge' dested Wedge Antilles; 'R-3P0' dested R-3PO (Ar-Threepio); 'Freighter Captain' dested Ralltiir Freighter Captain; 'Luke's Stick' dested Luke's Lightsaber; 'Merc Armor' dested Mercenary Armor.

Posted 'Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes/Lando in the Tube' dested the Reflections II combo Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & Out Of Somewhere (Out Of Somewhere shows Lando rescuing Luke from the Falcon's hatch; the author calls it his retrieval).
Posted 'I'm On the Leader' under Admiral's Orders dested I'll Take The Leader: I'm On The Leader is a Dark interrupt, and I'll Take The Leader is the Light Admiral's Order of that name.
Posted 'Don't Get @#$y' dested Don't Get Cocky; 'Control/Tunnel Vision', 'OOC/TT' and 'Houjix/Out of Nowhere' dested as the combo interrupts.
